backend/main.mo: Stores and manages a list of MappingInfo records with add, delete-by-time-range, and query functions.
feature_evidence.json: Defines a feature evidence report describing implementation details, files, and metadata for a persistent bottom CTA feature.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten textual summaries for various frontend source files.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Provides step-by-step instructions for deploying the Techify landing page to the Internet Computer.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS layers and OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up React Query and renders the Techify landing page.
frontend/src/components/PersistentBottom: Renders a fixed bottom CTA bar with price info and a Buy button calling a provided handler.
frontend/src/constants/techify.ts: Exports contact info, UPI details, WhatsApp messages, pricing, and a list of Canva Pro features.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and refreshes a backend actor based on Internet Identity state and invalidates dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context, loading, login, and identity management using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useLivePurchases.ts: Placeholder file for live purchase logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Minimal placeholder indicating feature-specific hooks are used instead of centralized queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useRecordPurchaseEven: Empty placeholder for a purchase-event recording hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useSimulatedLivePurch: Simulates purchase activity client-side with incrementing totals and aging timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpiPayment.ts: Provides a hook to start a UPI payment, show a fallback UI, and copy the UPI ID with modern and legacy clipboard support.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind base styles, color variables, dark mode themes, and custom utilities including gradients and safe-area padding.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/TechifyLandingPage.ts: Implements the main marketing landing page with payment CTAs, WhatsApp links, testimonials, form handling, and simulated purchase counters.
frontend/src/utils/clipboard.ts: Implements robust clipboard copy functionality using modern APIs with a textarea fallback.
frontend/src/utils/upi.ts: Generates UPI deep links and WhatsApp links for support, payment confirmation, and form submissions.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, radii, fonts, animations, and plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, issues, and architecture notes for the Techify landing page build.
